article_title: France's political mainstream risks presidential vote debacle with no clear candidate
adaptation_summary: Adapted for level C; emphasis on article-specific comprehension, vocabulary in context, and concise written responses.

tasks.prompt: What is the article's central argument?
options: France's mainstream risks being excluded from the presidential run-off because it lacks a unified, prepared candidate
Marine Le Pen and Jean-Luc Mélenchon have agreed to form a coalition
Emmanuel Macron is eligible to seek another term and leads every poll
The centre-right has already selected David Lisnard through a primary
tasks.correct_answer: France's mainstream risks being excluded from the presidential run-off because it lacks a unified, prepared candidate
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הטענה המרכזית היא שהמרכז הפוליטי עלול להיעלם מסיבוב ההכרעה בגלל פיצול והיעדר מועמד מוכן ומאוחד.

tasks.prompt: Who is identified as the agreed candidate of the old Socialist Party and its allies?
options: Edouard Philippe
Raphaël Glucksmann
Bruno Retailleau
David Lisnard
tasks.explanation_hebrew: רפאל גלוקסמן מזוהה כמועמד שעליו מסכימים הסוציאליסטים ובעלי בריתם.

tasks.prompt: Why would a mainstream candidate theoretically be strong in a second-round contest?
options: Both leading radical candidates face more opposition than support outside their bases
The constitution guarantees victory to the centrist candidate
Le Pen and Mélenchon cannot legally enter the second round
Macron can transfer all presidential powers to a successor
tasks.correct_answer: Both leading radical candidates face more opposition than support outside their bases
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המאמר מסביר שללה פן ולמלנשון יש מתנגדים רבים, ולכן מועמד מרכזי עשוי לאחד נגדם רוב בסיבוב שני.

tasks.prompt: What does “put paid to” mean in the sentence about hopes for a meaningful challenge?
options: Provided money for
Made widely popular
Delayed until election day
Ended or prevented
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי put paid to פירושו לשים קץ לתקווה או למנוע את מימושה.

tasks.prompt: What major weakness does Nicolas Baverez identify in the political space between Le Pen and Mélenchon?
options: It lacks a strategy, programme, activists and an effective digital campaign
It has too many trained activists and published programmes
It refuses to use television but dominates social media
It has already selected a single candidate too early
tasks.correct_answer: It lacks a strategy, programme, activists and an effective digital campaign
tasks.explanation_hebrew: באוורז מתאר חלל ללא אסטרטגיה, תוכנית, פעילים ונוכחות דיגיטלית אפקטיבית.

tasks.prompt: What platform does David Lisnard promote?
options: More state ownership and higher taxes
A return to Macron's neither-left-nor-right formula
Less state and lower taxes
A joint economic programme with Mélenchon
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ליסנאר מקדם מצע ליברלי כלכלי של פחות מדינה ומסים נמוכים יותר.

tasks.prompt: Explain how the large number of centre-right contenders weakens the mainstream challenge.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שהריבוי מעיד על היעדר מנהיג מוסכם, מפצל קולות ותשומת לב, ומחליף הכנת מצע ומערך פעילים בוויכוחים על שמות ופריימריז.
expected_points: No candidate has established clear authority over the centre-right field.
Multiple contenders divide support and make coordination harder.
Debate focuses on names, polling and a possible primary rather than a shared platform.
The fragmented field contrasts with the prepared campaigns of Le Pen and Mélenchon.

tasks.prompt: Why is association with Emmanuel Macron a problem for several mainstream candidates?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שפיליפ, אטאל וריטאיו כיהנו תחת מקרון, אך מקרון אינו פופולרי ונחשב רעיל פוליטית, ולכן הקשר אליו מכביד עליהם.
expected_points: Philippe, Attal and Retailleau all served under Macron.
Macron is deeply unpopular in France.
Commentators describe him as politically toxic.
Lisnard tries to benefit from having refused to serve under Macron.

tasks.prompt: Write 4–5 sentences assessing whether David Lisnard is likely to become a durable mainstream alternative.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לאזן בין העלייה המהירה, מאה אלף חברי המפלגה והשפה בנושא הגירה, לבין בסיסו המצומצם של ליברליזם כלכלי בצרפת והתחזית שיאבד תנופה.
expected_points: Lisnard has risen quickly and his micro-party has more than 100,000 members.
His immigration language attracts voters on the right who do not want Le Pen.
He is viewed as a possible replacement for Edouard Philippe.
However, his economic liberalism appeals to only a minority in France.
Fressoz predicts his surge will fade after a temporary moment.

tasks.prompt: Summarise why Le Pen and Mélenchon hold an advantage over France's mainstream ahead of 2027.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את הניסיון משלוש מערכות, חזון ואסטרטגיה מוכנים, פעילים מאומנים, שליטה במחנותיהם, קמפיינים דיגיטליים וקיטוב חברתי.
expected_points: Both leaders have already run for president three times.
Their political visions and strategies were defined long ago.
They have trained activists and command their respective camps.
Polarisation and recent social tension benefit them while mainstream rivals remain divided and unprepared.
